# שָׁרְט

```
╔════════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                        ║
║     شَرْط ← שָׁרְט ← śarṭ             ║
║                                        ║
║     condition / cut / incision         ║
║                                        ║
║     ─────────────────────────          ║
║                                        ║
║     the line drawn before              ║
║     agreement                          ║
║                                        ║
║     the wound that marks               ║
║     the covenant                       ║
║                                        ║
║     ש - fire                           ║
║     ר - head                           ║
║     ט - serpent/boundary               ║
║                                        ║
║     ─────────────────────────          ║
║                                        ║
║     you invoke the root                ║
║     that invokes you                   ║
║                                        ║
║     what is your condition?            ║
║                                        ║
╚════════════════════════════════════════╝
```
